ranking.name: AC Hotel by Marriott New Orleans French Quarter

text.text_excerpt: The hotel is in a great location. It is on the same road that once it crosses Canal, it turns into Bourbon Street. It is a block from the parade routes of St. Charles so its a GREAT spot if you are all about parading. There are lots of places around it too to eat or grab a togo cup. The staff are great and friendly. Nice restaurant and breakfast. A few items: 1) We never received hand towels or small towels on our 2nd day. Not sure why, but we had our old ones removed, but never received the new ones. 2) Great bed and TV setup, rooms are nice and spacious and the floor in our room was NOT carpet, but wood laminate, which was nice, because no fear of what may have been in carpet. 3) Great ...

For the price, location and facilities, AC Marriott can not be beat! Lobby, rooms, bathrooms are modern, clean, comfortable and upscale. Beds were extremely comfortable! Loved the modern feel throughout the hotel. The location is perfect for tourists. Within a block or two of all the French Quater happenings. Our one dissatisfaction was the manager, terrible customer service, rude, condescending, snobby. Every interaction I witnessed her have with guests was not positive. I try to give people the benefit of the doubt but I've worked in HR for 20 years and can not understand how she keeps her job. Honestly no other words can describe her attitude besides the ones above. All the other emplo...

Ok, so to start, I'm a regular Marriott user because I travel sometimes 3 weeks out of the month and I love taking advantage of the rewards program. With that being said, this is unlike any other Marriott I have stayed with. I chose this location because even tho I was coming here for work, I wanted to be close to the action too! ( this was my first visit to New Orleans) Upon arrival, late in the night because of delayed flights, i was greeted with a smile from the valet who took my car off to an undisclosed location and I went inside.
